name: Inkbox
description: Persistent identities for AI agents: each gets an email inbox, phone number for calls and SMS, iMessage, WhatsApp, a public tunnel URL and a credential vault, via API, CLI, SDKs or MCP.

skills.name: Create Agent Email Inboxes
skills.description: Create an agent identity with its own mailbox to send and receive email, manage threads and drafts, on custom domains.

skills.name: Provision a Phone Number
skills.description: Give an agent a phone number to place and answer calls with transcripts, or have Inkbox Voice AI handle calls.

skills.name: Send and Receive iMessages
skills.description: Reach people over iMessage, SMS/MMS and WhatsApp from an agent's number, with tapbacks and contact rules.

skills.name: Vault Agent Credentials
skills.description: Store encrypted credentials and shared notes that agents can access under per-identity access control.

skills.name: Expose a Public Tunnel
skills.description: Give an agent a stable public URL that routes inbound HTTP, WebSocket and raw TCP traffic to its local server.
